theme: 教材片語・中高階 750–850 第 15 群

items.colloc: make an accurate forecast 精確預測 | make a sales forecast 做出銷售預測
items.distinct: predict 預測（動詞） | projection 預估值
ex: The analyst will make forecast for the next quarter.
分析師將為下一季做出預測。
It is difficult to make forecast during market volatility.
在市場波動期間很難做出預測。
Our team needs to make forecast regarding annual revenue.
我們的團隊需要對年度營收做出預測。

items.colloc: make money quickly 快速賺錢 | make money from investments 從投資中獲利
items.distinct: earn a living 維持生計 | generate profit 產生利潤
ex: Their primary goal is to make money for shareholders.
他們的主要目標是為股東賺錢。
Many startups struggle to make money in the early stages.
許多新創公司在早期階段很難獲利。
Investing in technology can help you make money.
投資科技產業有助於你賺錢。

items.colloc: make the first move in negotiations 在談判中採取主動 | wait for someone to make the first move 等待對方採取主動
items.distinct: take the initiative 採取主動權 | strike first 先下手為強
ex: It is time for us to make the first move.
現在是我們採取主動的時候了。
He decided to make the first move to close the deal.
他決定採取主動來達成這筆交易。
Sometimes it pays to make the first move in business.
有時在商場上先發制人是有利的。

items.colloc: assess market value 評估市場價值 | exceed market value 超過市場價值
items.distinct: book value 帳面價值 | asset value 資產價值
ex: The company has a high market value right now.
這家公司目前有很高的市場價值。
We need to determine the market value of the property.
我們需要確定該房產的市場價值。
Changes in the economy affect the market value of stocks.
經濟變化影響股票的市場價值。

items.colloc: move forward with the plan 推進計畫 | move forward to the next stage 進入下一階段
items.distinct: go ahead 進行；同意 | carry on 繼續進行
ex: We are ready to move forward with the merger.
我們準備推進合併案。
The board decided to move forward despite the risks.
董事會決定儘管有風險仍繼續推進。
Please let us know how to move forward from here.
請讓我們知道接下來該如何進行。

items.colloc: much to one's surprise and delight 令某人又驚又喜 | much to everyone's surprise 令大家驚訝的是
items.distinct: to one's astonishment 令某人震驚的是 | unexpectedly 意外地
ex: Much to our surprise, the project was completed early.
令我們驚訝的是，該專案提前完成了。
Much to his surprise, he received a promotion today.
令他驚訝的是，他今天獲得了晉升。
The client canceled the order, much to our surprise.
令我們驚訝的是，客戶取消了訂單。

items.colloc: a newly established company 一家新成立的公司 | a newly established policy 一項新設立的政策
items.distinct: newly founded 新創立的 | newly created 新創造的
ex: The newly established department handles client complaints.
這個新成立的部門負責處理客戶投訴。
He works for a newly established firm in Taipei.
他在台北一家新成立的公司工作。
The newly established rules apply to all employees.
這些新設立的規則適用於所有員工。

items.zh: 禁止進入的；禁止觸碰的
items.colloc: be off limits to staff 對員工禁止進入 | declare an area off limits 宣布該區域為禁區
items.distinct: restricted 限制的 | prohibited 被禁止的
ex: The laboratory is off limits to unauthorized personnel.
實驗室禁止未經授權的人員進入。
Discussing salaries is off limits in this meeting.
在這次會議中禁止討論薪資問題。
The executive office is off limits during lunch time.
午餐時間行政辦公室禁止進入。

items.colloc: hold an official title 擁有正式職稱 | use an official title 使用正式頭銜
items.distinct: job description 工作描述 | position 職位
ex: What is your official title in this organization?
你在這個組織裡的正式職稱是什麼？
He prefers to use his official title on business cards.
他偏好在名片上使用他的正式職稱。
Her official title changed after the restructuring.
組織重組後她的正式職稱改變了。

items.colloc: put on the waiting list 列入候補名單 | remain on the waiting list 停留在候補名單
items.distinct: on standby 備用狀態 | at a queue 排隊中
ex: I am currently on the waiting list for the seminar.
我目前在研討會的候補名單上。
Many clients are on the waiting list for this service.
許多客戶都在這項服務的候補名單上。
Can you put my name on the waiting list?
你可以把我的名字加到候補名單上嗎？

items.colloc: book a one way ticket 預訂單程票 | purchase a one way ticket 購買單程票
items.distinct: round trip ticket 來回票 | return ticket 回程票
ex: He bought a one way ticket for his business trip.
他買了一張出差用的單程票。
The company prefers booking a one way ticket for flexibility.
公司為了靈活性傾向預訂單程票。
I only need a one way ticket to the conference.
我只需要一張去開會的單程票。

items.colloc: order a meal online 線上點餐 | order a meal for delivery 點餐外送
items.distinct: place an order 下訂單 | reserve a table 訂位
ex: We can order a meal before the meeting starts.
我們可以在會議開始前先點餐。
It is convenient to order a meal through the app.
透過應用程式點餐很方便。
She helped the guests order a meal at the hotel.
她協助客人在飯店點餐。

items.colloc: use the parking garage 使用停車場 | enter the parking garage 進入停車場
items.distinct: parking lot 停車場（平面） | street parking 路邊停車
ex: The office building has a spacious parking garage.
辦公大樓有一個寬敞的立體停車場。
Visitors can park in the underground parking garage.
訪客可以停在地下停車場。
She parked her car in the parking garage nearby.
她把車停在附近的立體停車場。

items.colloc: pass by the office 路過辦公室 | pass by the building 經過建築物
items.distinct: go past 經過 | drop by 順道拜訪
ex: I will pass by your desk later this afternoon.
今天下午稍晚我會經過你的座位。
Did you pass by the construction site today?
你今天有經過工地嗎？
The courier will pass by to pick up the parcel.
快遞員會順道過來領取包裹。

items.colloc: cater to people of all ages 滿足所有年齡層的人 | attract people of all ages 吸引各年齡層的人
items.distinct: all age groups 所有年齡組 | various age groups 各種年齡組
ex: The event is suitable for people of all ages.
這個活動適合所有年齡層的人參與。
Our products are designed for people of all ages.
我們的產品專為所有年齡層的人設計。
This park attracts people of all ages every weekend.
這個公園每個週末都吸引各年齡層的人。

items.colloc: post a notice on the board 在佈告欄貼公告 | post a notice on the wall 在牆上貼公告
items.distinct: put up a sign 豎立標誌 | announce an update 發布更新
ex: The manager will post a notice on the bulletin board.
經理將在佈告欄張貼公告。
Please post a notice on the door regarding the closure.
請在門上張貼關於關閉的公告。
They decided to post a notice on the company website.
他們決定在公司網站上張貼公告。

items.colloc: provided that the terms are met 只要條件符合 | provided that we agree 假設我們同意
items.distinct: on condition that 在...條件下 | as long as 只要
ex: We can proceed provided that you sign the contract.
只要你簽署合約，我們就可以繼續進行。
The deal is valid provided that the funds are cleared.
只要資金到位，這筆交易即有效。
You may take leave provided that your work is finished.
只要你的工作完成了，你就可以請假。

items.colloc: pull down the old building 拆除舊建築 | pull down the shades 拉下遮陽簾
items.distinct: tear down 拆除 | take down 拆卸
ex: The city plans to pull down the old warehouse.
市政府計畫拆除這座舊倉庫。
They decided to pull down the posters before the event.
他們決定在活動前把海報取下。
Workers will pull down the structure next month.
工人下個月將拆除這個建築結構。

items.colloc: pull into the station 駛入車站 | pull into the driveway 駛入車道
items.distinct: drive into 開進 | enter 進入
ex: The train will pull into the station shortly.
火車即將駛入車站。
He slowly pulled into the parking space.
他緩慢地將車開入停車位。
We watched the bus pull into the depot.
我們看著巴士駛入車廠。

items.colloc: put away the files 收拾檔案 | put away documents 整理文件
items.distinct: pack up 打包 | store away 儲藏
ex: Please put away your reports after the meeting.
會議結束後請把你的報告收拾好。
She took a moment to put away the office supplies.
她花了一點時間收拾辦公用品。
Make sure to put away all sensitive documents securely.
務必將所有機密文件妥善收好。
